Axis: applicant
- Register: "MeteRsit"
- Document: "MeteRSit S.r.l"

The document is the actual certificate, and it says "MeteRSit S.r.l" with address "Viale dell'Industria, 34 35129 Padova Italy". The register says "MeteRsit".

Is this same-entity? "MeteRsit" vs "MeteRSit" — capitalization difference in the "RS" part ("Rsit" vs "RSit"). That's spelling/case drift, and "S.r.l" is a legal suffix (Italian "Società a responsabilità limitata"). Legal-suffix drift = same-entity per rules.

So verdict: same-entity. Best value: should it be the document's fuller form "MeteRSit S.r.l"? The rules say number/year format differences that clearly denote the same certificate = same-entity with register's canonical form. But for same-entity with legal-suffix drift, what's the best value? The rules say for same-entity cases, presumably the best value is the most complete/accurate. The document is the legal instrument, and "MeteRSit S.r.l" is the fuller legal name. The rule about register canonical form applies specifically to "Number/year format differences". For applicant names, the fused record should probably carry the document's fuller legal name since it's more precise.

Actually, let me re-read: "spelling drift, legal-suffix drift, accent differences = same-entity." It doesn't specify best_value for these. "Extraction artifacts... = document-noise with best_value from the register." "Genuinely different company or person names = different-entity (best_value = the document's, since the certificate is the legal instrument)." "Number/year format differences that clearly denote the same certificate = same-entity with the register's canonical form."

For same-entity due to spelling/legal-suffix drift, the best value would sensibly be the document's fuller legal form — the certificate is the legal instrument, and "MeteRSit S.r.l" is the complete legal name. The register's "MeteRsit" is a truncated form. So best_value = "MeteRSit S.r.l".

Note the certificate text shows "MeteRSit S.r.l" (with proper capitalization) while the register shows "MeteRsit" (lowercase 's'). The document has the more accurate legal name.
